primary_claim: A tuned lens directly trained on text-token geometry decodes CODI's final answer from odd latent reasoning steps (1, 3, 5) where plain logit lens cannot, while a tuned lens trained directly on CODI's latent hidden states underperforms and overfits, suggesting CODI's latent vectors remain close to text-token geometry and alternate between computation (odd, high-entropy steps) and storage (even steps, highest answer-detection rate).

effect.metric: final-answer detection rate / entropy across CODI latent reasoning steps
effect.value: direct-trained tuned lens decodes final answer at odd latent steps 1,3,5 (plain logit lens cannot); highest final-answer top-k detection rate at even steps 2,4; entropy peaks at odd steps 3,5; using only latents 3,5 fails to decode the answer

stated_future_work: Observe final answer detection rate and see if latents 2 and 4 have the highest accuracy for different top-k values
Try other methods like patchscopes, activation oracles, etc. on the latent reasoning
Attempt to create thought anchors that work with CODI latent reasoning models
